name: Yami no Etsuraku
source:
Underground tournament promises huge 300 million yen reward if beloved woman can withstand  training for three days, but loser women become sex slaves. A lot of women accumulate debts and agree to participate in this tournament while their lovers and relatives can only bite lips observing dear people in shocking situations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一场地下比赛开出高达3亿日元的奖金：只要心爱的女人能撑过三天调教，就能赢得这笔巨款；而失败的女人则会沦为性奴。许多背负债务的女性答应参赛，她们的恋人与亲属只能咬紧嘴唇，眼看着珍视的人陷入触目惊心的境地。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
